protocol: 80 min at 24,000 ft. Eight men in a repeat crossover, with at least 72 h between trials. Ascent and descent 5,000 ft/min. Chamber air during initial ascent and final descent below 10,000 ft, and premixed 46.5% oxygen during transitions between 10,000 and 24,000 ft. The rebreather targeted inspired oxygen partial pressure of 21 kPa. VGE and clinical symptoms were checked every 5 min. Knee bends were performed every 15 min.
outcome_window: During the chamber trial. Fixed delayed follow-up is unspecified.
note: VGE was observed in the right ventricle in every subject. Figure 2 reports a plotted population of eight.
